description_expanded: MYSTIC SEAS - 30A Townhome with Community Pool Favorite Features: - Two Community Pools - Five Minute Walk to The Big Chill 30A More About Mystic Seas: Welcome to your perfect coastal retreat in Prominence on 30A, a vibrant community situated along Scenic Highway 30A between Seagrove Beach and Alys Beach. This beautifully furnished 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom townhome offers comfort, style, and convenience for families, friends, or couples looking to experience the best of the Emerald Coast. Inside you’ll find a bright, open living space with coastal décor and a fully equipped kitchen, plus plenty of room to relax after beach days, pool days, or bike rides along the scenic 30A trail. Prominence on 30A features two resort-style community pools — including a zero-entry pool and ample lounging space perfect for both kids and adults — along with picnic and grilling areas, green spaces, and direct access to miles of walking and biking paths. Just across the street from the neighborhood is The Big Chill 30a, the lively 30A town center where you can dine, shop, and enjoy entertainment. With a variety of restaurants, bars, live music, outdoor events, and boutique shops nearby, you’ll have plenty of options for meals and fun without a long drive. The location also puts you within easy reach of some of 30A’s best eateries and attractions — whether you’re craving Southern comfort, fresh seafood, casual brunch spots, or classic coastal fare. Explore local favorites like Perfect Pig Grill and Fish House for Southern-inspired dishes, Chanticleer Eatery for made-from-scratch meals, or Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar for seafood with a view — and be sure to enjoy a beach day at the sugar-white sands just a short bike or golf cart ride away. With community pools, eateries, entertainment, and beaches all so close, this townhome is the perfect home base for your 30A getaway!
